verdict.rationale: Neon documents an official serverless driver (@neondatabase/serverless) purpose-built for HTTP and WebSocket queries from serverless/edge runtimes, plus connection pooling docs and Neon Local for short-lived connection scenarios [neon-docs-14, neon-docs-31, neon-docs-13, neon-docs-30]. Community evidence corroborates the value of this pay-per-call, gateway-free model for serverless workloads [neon-comm-1]. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks specifically testing the HTTP/WebSocket driver's edge performance, and explicit documentation quoting HTTP vs WebSocket query examples in the evidence pack.
